description:
List authored AR invoices, newest first.

Optional ``status`` / ``doc_type`` filter by lifecycle + document kind.
Optional ``period`` (``YYYY-MM``) filters by the invoice's issue date (its
month); a malformed value returns 422 ``{"msg": "period must be YYYY-MM"}``.

anyOf.description:
Editorial lifecycle owned by ``ar_invoice`` (paid/overdue are derived on
read from the linked ``gl_open_item``, not stored here).

name: list_ar_invoices
